trendMeta.note: The 2020 decline coincided with COVID-19 restrictions and reduced travel. It should not be interpreted as a lasting safety gain.

comparisons.title: India & Viet Nam
comparisons.text: Substantial motorcycle use makes helmet protection and enforcement relevant. Population, road types, reporting and travel patterns limit simple comparisons.

comparisons.title: India & Singapore
comparisons.text: Useful lessons in enforcement and data transparency come from a small, highly urbanized setting, unlike many Indian rural and mixed-traffic contexts.

comparisons.title: Singapore & Viet Nam
comparisons.text: Compare governance and implementation models. A country league table would hide differences in exposure and reporting.

comparisonNote: The report does not provide a complete, comparable mortality-rate dataset for India, Viet Nam and Singapore. A numerical country ranking would not be supported.
